description: Check a backend directory for architecture problems: routes that reach data without authenticating, sensitive data sent to third parties, open row-level security, and more. Returns each NEW finding with its risk, the file and line, what is missing, and a suggested patch where one applies. Findings already recorded in the repository's baseline are counted as existing debt, not reported as new. Also returns whether CI would pass, the engine version, and an `action` (none, mention, fix) saying whether the task can be reported done. Reads TypeScript, JavaScript, Python and SAP CAP (Express, NestJS, Next.js, FastAPI, Prisma, Drizzle, TypeORM, Mongoose, SQLAlchemy, Supabase).

include_existing.description: Also list findings already recorded in the baseline. Default false: only what is new matters for the change in hand.

path.description: Directory to read: the backend's root, absolute or relative to the working directory. Defaults to the working directory.

name: check_backend
title: Check backend architecture
